project.name: NEVZ
project.scope_note: This report describes the uploaded NEVZ archive scanned by the local INVEST instance. It is not a scan report for the INVEST repository itself.

source_manifest.note: Per-file paths and hashes are intentionally omitted from this report.

security_gate.interpretation: The run was not blocked. Four MEDIUM findings triggered a warning.

ai_explain.evidence_observation: Each explanation contained five evidence lines; all five were identical redaction markers of 41 characters. No original source context was available to the model.
ai_explain.assessment: Processing coverage is 100%, but substantive classification quality is not established. The model repeated the scanner rule and generic remediation advice; it did not establish whether the matched values are active credentials, placeholders, or test data.
ai_explain.output_encoding_issue: Russian recommendation and evidence-limit strings were observed as mojibake in the PowerShell/API output. The precise layer causing the encoding issue has not yet been isolated.

limitations: The four SECRET findings are candidates, not confirmed active credentials. The original values are deliberately excluded.
The source files were not independently inspected because the protected source-preview path redacts complete SECRET-bearing files.
Zero SCA and SAST findings means those scanners reported no findings in this run; it is not a proof that the source is vulnerability-free.
No GitHub webhook delivery or GitHub-side workflow execution is established by this local UI run.
AI Explain completion counters measure processing coverage, not correctness of the model's conclusions.
recommended_follow_up: Trace where finding.code_context is constructed and sanitized before AI Explain.
Introduce a separate, secret-safe AI evidence contract that masks matched values while preserving useful structural context.
Add tests proving secrets never reach the model in clear text and redaction placeholders are not treated as meaningful evidence.
Add semantic validation so a response based only on redaction markers is marked insufficient_evidence rather than fully explained.
Investigate UTF-8 handling for AI explanation fields end-to-end.
Review the four candidate assignments in the original NEVZ project and rotate any credential confirmed to be real.
